name: Aldamon
main_effect:
When one of your Digimon with a Tamer card in its digivolution cards would digivolve into this card in your hand, reduce the memory cost of the digivolution by 2.
[When Digivolving] If a card with the [Hybrid] trait is in this Digimon's digivolution cards, this Digimon gets +4000 DP for the turn.
source_effect: [Your Turn] While this Digimon has the [Hybrid] or [Ten Warriors] trait, it doesn't activate [Security] effects on Option cards it checks.
